qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Consistently the most efficient and credit-disciplined mid-size Spanish bank (cost-to-income ~37%, industry-low NPLs). Sticky wealth management franchise and successful organic expansion in Portugal and Ireland (Avant Money), but lending spreads remain commodity credit.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Spain's premier mid-size banking franchise, combining disciplined underwriting (lowest NPLs in Spain) and wealth management with organic growth in Portugal and Ireland. However, commercial banking is an interest-rate-dependent spread business facing cyclical margin contraction as ECB rates fall, limiting CAP to 10 years.
qualitative.evidence: FY25 net income reached €1,048.6M with Owner EPS of 1.17, up from €544.9M in FY22, propelled by ECB rate hikes. Balance sheet maintains €18.0B cash and disciplined asset quality. Despite best-in-class Spanish banking execution, spread-lending does not meet the 15-year secular moat persistence threshold.
